keyFindings.description: dispatch search prints every ask-block hit as <document>#b-<id>. Main's dispatchRefFromUrl read that URL as the document; the head reads it as the block. For an ask block whose id is past 256 bytes, or whose block a later edit removed, `dispatch read --ref <hit>` now exits 1 'No block <id> in <doc>' (dispatch-execute.ts:4096-4099), where main read the document. The census's line-82 disposition ('0 hits' for block-anchored URLs in text an agent reads) misses this producer. Fix: name the ask in the hit (?ask=<id> or /asks/<id>), or fall back to the document; then correct the census.

The bounded parseDispatchReference still decides what the dashboard draws and opens for an explicitly named node: pictureReference (routes.ts:663) and collectPictureAnchors (DispatchPicture.tsx), collectReferenceAnchors via referenceRouteFromHref (RefLink.tsx:159), and ProofDocument's click handler (:780). A picture or markdown link to a document whose key is 2,049-2,692 bytes, which main rendered and opened, is not drawn and is a dead link at the head. Use parseNodeReference/nodeRouteFromHref there; keep the bound only for turning plain text into links.
